title: Embodied Semantic Communication for Collective Autonomous Agents: A Tutorial on Representation, Wireless Delivery, and Closed-Loop Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2609.35936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As autonomous systems and embodied intelligence enter the dynamic physical world, multi-agent collaboration calls for a paradigm shift in communication design. However, existing communication paradigms overlook that agents form action understanding from their own states, environmental observations, and collaboration relations through a process that evolves as a task unfolds. Consequently, reliable bit delivery, general semantic recovery, or single-task utility optimization alone cannot ensure that heterogeneous agents form coordinated actions compatible with their own conditions from shared information during task execution. To address this gap, this paper proposes embodied semantic communication (ESC) as a paradigm that transforms information transmission into action-oriented semantic interaction. translated_title: 面向群体自主智能体的具身语义通信：表示、无线传输与闭环协调教程
translated_abstract: 随着自主系统与具身智能进入动态物理世界，多智能体协作要求通信设计发生范式转变。然而，现有的通信范式忽视了这样一个事实：智能体是从自身状态、环境观测和协作关系中形成对行动的理解，而这一过程会随着任务的展开不断演化。因此，仅靠可靠的比特传输、通用的语义恢复或单任务效用优化，无法确保异构智能体在任务执行过程中从共享信息中形成与自身条件相兼容的协调行动。为弥合这一差距，本文提出了具身语义通信（ESC）这一范式，将信息传输转变为面向行动的语义交互。具体而言，ESC刻画了显式通信链路如何能够封装多模态感知状态、内在硬件能力……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出具身语义通信（ESC）新范式，将信息传输转变为面向行动的语义交互，使异构自主智能体在任务执行中能够从共享信息形成与自身条件相兼容的协调行动。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Embodied Semantic Communication (ESC), a new paradigm that transforms information transmission into action-oriented semantic interaction, enabling heterogeneous autonomous agents to form coordinated actions compatible with their own conditions from shared information during task execution.
